disclaimer: Facts-only snapshot of public Groww scheme pages. Not investment advice.

schemes.name: SBI Small Cap Fund Direct Growth
schemes.exit_load: Exit load of 1% if redeemed within 1 year
schemes.tax_implication: If you redeem within one year, returns are taxed at 20%. If you redeem after one year, returns exceeding Rs 1.25 lakh in a financial year are taxed at 12.5%.
schemes.lock_in: None stated on the Groww page (not an ELSS scheme).
schemes.investment_objective: The scheme seeks to provide investors with opportunities for long-term growth in capital along with the liquidity of an open-ended scheme by investing predominantly in a well diversified basket of equity stocks of small cap companies.

schemes.name: SBI Mid Cap Direct Plan Growth
schemes.exit_load: Exit load of 0.25% if redeemed within 30 days and 0.10% if redeemed after 30 days but on or before 90 days.
schemes.tax_implication: If you redeem within one year, returns are taxed at 20%. If you redeem after one year, returns exceeding Rs 1.25 lakh in a financial year are taxed at 12.5%.
schemes.lock_in: None stated on the Groww page (not an ELSS scheme).
schemes.investment_objective: The scheme aims to provide investors with opportunities for long term growth in capital along with the liquidity of an open-ended scheme by investing predominantly in a well-diversified basket of equity stocks of Midcap companies.

schemes.name: SBI Large Cap Direct Plan Growth
schemes.exit_load: Exit load of 0.25% if redeemed within 30 days and 0.10% if redeemed after 30 days but on or before 90 days.
schemes.tax_implication: If you redeem within one year, returns are taxed at 20%. If you redeem after one year, returns exceeding Rs 1.25 lakh in a financial year are taxed at 12.5%.
schemes.lock_in: None stated on the Groww page (not an ELSS scheme).
schemes.investment_objective: The scheme seeks to provide investors with opportunities for long-term growth in capital through an active management of investments in a diversified basket of large cap equity stocks (as specified by SEBI/AMFI from time to time).

schemes.name: SBI Nifty Next 50 Index Fund Direct Growth
schemes.exit_load: Exit load of 0.25% if redeemed within 30 days.
schemes.tax_implication: If you redeem within one year, returns are taxed at 20%. If you redeem after one year, returns exceeding Rs 1.25 lakh in a financial year are taxed at 12.5%.
schemes.lock_in: None stated on the Groww page (not an ELSS scheme).
schemes.investment_objective: The scheme seeks to provide returns that closely correspond to the total returns of the securities as represented by the underlying index, subject to tracking error.

schemes.name: SBI Gold Direct Plan Growth
schemes.exit_load: Exit load of 1% if redeemed within 15 days.
schemes.tax_implication: If you redeem within two years, returns are taxed as per your Income Tax slab. If you redeem after two years, returns are taxed at 12.5%.
schemes.lock_in: None stated on the Groww page (not an ELSS scheme).
schemes.investment_objective: The Scheme seeks to provide returns that closely correspond to returns provided by SBI Gold Exchange Traded Scheme (SBI GETS).
schemes.holdings_note: Groww holdings show SBI ETF Gold at 100.07% of assets (fund-of-fund structure), plus small repo/net payables.

schemes.name: SBI ELSS Tax Saver Fund Direct Growth
schemes.tax_implication: If you redeem within one year, returns are taxed at 20%. If you redeem after one year, returns exceeding Rs 1.25 lakh in a financial year are taxed at 12.5%. Groww also labels the scheme ELSS with a 3-year lock-in.
schemes.lock_in: 3-year lock-in (Groww label: ELSS • 3Y Lock-in). Units cannot be redeemed before completion of the lock-in as applicable to ELSS.
schemes.investment_objective: The scheme seeks capital appreciation through investments in equities, cumulative convertible preference shares and fully convertible debentures and bonds. The scheme was converted into an open-ended plan in November 1999.

schemes.name: SBI Flexicap Fund Direct Growth
schemes.exit_load: Exit load of 0.10% if redeemed within 30 days.
schemes.tax_implication: If you redeem within one year, returns are taxed at 20%. If you redeem after one year, returns exceeding Rs 1.25 lakh in a financial year are taxed at 12.5%.
schemes.lock_in: None stated on the Groww page (not an ELSS scheme).
schemes.benchmark: Not printed as a named index line on the Groww ‘About’ block in this snapshot; verify on the scheme page / SID.
schemes.investment_objective: The scheme would invest in equities and equity related instruments of companies spanning the entire market capitalization spectrum. The fund will invest 50-90 per cent in large-cap stocks, 10-40 per cent in mid-cap stocks and upto 10 per cent in small-cap stocks.

glossary.text: A fee payable to a mutual fund house for managing your mutual fund investments. It is the total percentage of a company's fund assets used for administrative, management, advertising, and other expenses.
A fee payable to a mutual fund house for exiting a fund (fully or partially) before the completion of a specified period from the date of investment.
A form of tax payable for the purchase or sale of an asset or security. Stamp duty on investment: 0.005% (from July 1st, 2020).

glossary.term: Tax (capital gains — equity-oriented, as printed on these Groww pages)
glossary.text: Taxation is categorized as long-term capital gains (LTCG) and short-term capital gains (STCG) depending on holding period and type of fund. Equity-oriented pages in this corpus state: if you redeem within one year, returns are taxed at 20%; if you redeem after one year, returns exceeding Rs 1.25 lakh in a financial year are taxed at 12.5%. Gold fund tax text differs (two-year holding).
